0ca49a78629997f7.sql: -- Critic, plan review: what GeBIZ data exists for this agency and period? -- n_period = awards inside the requested period; n_etq = quotation (ETQ) records for the agency (R4 needs them to be complete). -- Params: 'People\'s Association' '2024-01-01' '2024-12-31' SELECT count(*) AS n_all, CAST(min(award_date) AS STRING) AS min_date, CAST(max(award_date) AS STRING) AS max_date, sum(CASE WHEN award_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_period, sum(CASE WHEN upper(tender_no) LIKE '%ETQ%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_etq FROM gebiz_pg.awards WHERE agency = 'People\'s Association'

1393aee5ee46a275.sql: -- R1: supplier incorporated less than 6 months (183 days) before the award date. -- Joins awards -> supplier_xwalk (Resolver) -> ACRA entities. Params: 'People\'s Association' '2024-01-01' '2024-12-31' SELECT 'R1' AS flag_id, a.tender_no, a.agency, a.supplier_name, e.uen, a.award_date, a.awarded_amt, 'incorporation_age_days' AS metric_name, datediff(a.award_date, e.registration_incorporation_date) AS metric_value, '183' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: ', e.entity_name, ' (', e.entity_type_description, ', ', e.entity_status_description, ') was incorporated ', CAST(e.registration_incorporation_date AS STRING), ', ', CAST(datediff(a.award_date, e.registration_incorporation_date) AS STRING), ' days before the award on ', CAST(a.award_date AS STRING), '. Resolver match: ', x.method, ' (confidence ', CAST(x.confidence AS STRING), ').') AS detail FROM gebiz_pg.awards a JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = a.supplier_name AND x.uen IS NOT NULL JOIN ACRA_FILES.entities e ON e.uen = x.uen WHERE a.agency = 'People\'s Association' AND a.award_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND datediff(a.award_date, e.registration_incorporation_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 183 ORDER BY metric_value ASC, a.awarded_amt DESC

f3e41d6b23a11bef.sql: -- R4: possible contract splitting. Same agency and supplier: >= 2 awards, each below S$90,000, within a 90-day -- window, together above S$90,000. One row per award that sits in at least one qualifying window. -- GeBIZ data here has tender (ETT) awards only, so splitting below the quotation band is under-detected. -- Params: 'People\'s Association' '2024-01-01' '2024-12-31' WITH s AS ( SELECT tender_no, agency, supplier_name, award_date, awarded_amt FROM gebiz_pg.awards WHERE agency = 'People\'s Association' AND award_date BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' AND awarded_amt > 0 AND awarded_amt < 90000 ), win AS ( SELECT s1.agency, s1.supplier_name, s1.award_date AS win_start, count(DISTINCT s2.tender_no) AS n_awards, sum(s2.awarded_amt) AS total_amt FROM s s1 JOIN s s2 ON s1.agency = s2.agency AND s1.supplier_name = s2.supplier_name AND s2.award_date BETWEEN s1.award_date AND date_add(s1.award_date, 90) GROUP BY s1.agency, s1.supplier_name, s1.award_date HAVING count(DISTINCT s2.tender_no) >= 2 AND sum(s2.awarded_amt) > 90000 ) SELECT 'R4' AS flag_id, m.tender_no, m.agency, m.supplier_name, max(x.uen) AS uen, m.award_date, m.awarded_amt, 'window_total_sgd' AS metric_name, max(w.total_amt) AS metric_value, '90000' AS threshold, concat('Anomaly for review: ', CAST(max(w.n_awards) AS STRING), ' sub-S$90k awards to this supplier within 90 days total S$', CAST(round(max(w.total_amt), 2) AS STRING), ' (window starting ', CAST(min(w.win_start) AS STRING), '), above the S$90k tender threshold. May indicate splitting; requires auditor judgement.') AS detail FROM s m JOIN win w ON w.agency = m.agency AND w.supplier_name = m.supplier_name AND m.award_date BETWEEN w.win_start AND date_add(w.win_start, 90) LEFT JOIN gebiz_pg.supplier_xwalk x ON x.supplier_name = m.supplier_name GROUP BY m.tender_no, m.agency, m.supplier_name, m.award_date, m.awarded_amt ORDER BY max(w.total_amt) DESC, m.supplier_name, m.award_date
